intent: Planner blueprint: PageHeader and a kit Calendar of team events.
doNot: Do not invent EventCalendar, Scheduler, MonthGrid, or DateGrid
Do not use DatePicker for this schedule — DatePicker is a form date field
Do not put a primary Button on the page — Calendar’s event Save is the primary action
Do not restyle kit Calendar internals
Do not invent a padded app shell. Product chrome is layout-shell (AppHeader, radius none) over layout-app (SideNav, radius none, showHeader false). No gap between header and nav.
